en-US.title: SayBright: Daily Affirmations
en-US.shortDescription: Daily affirmations for self love and confidence: five positive words each day
en-US.fullDescription:
SayBright gives you five daily affirmations every morning, picked for what you want more of. Say these positive affirmations out loud, save the ones that land, and build a self love habit that keeps you on your own side.

SAY IT OUT LOUD
SayBright starts with your first affirmation in under a minute. Pick what you want more of, read it, say it, and feel the difference a kind sentence makes.

FIVE A DAY, FREE
Every day brings five fresh affirmations from the topics you chose, the same five your morning reminder points to. Swipe through them, save your favorites, and come back tomorrow for five more.

TEN CATEGORIES, 340 AFFIRMATIONS
Confidence, Gratitude, Morning Energy, Self Love, Career Growth, Relationships, Health and Body, Wealth and Abundance, Calm and Anxiety Relief, and Creativity. Confidence affirmations are fully open on the free plan, and every other category lets you read a preview.

HEAR IT IN YOUR OWN VOICE
Record any affirmation in your own voice and play it back whenever you need it. Hearing your own words is a simple way to make positive self talk stick.

WRITE YOUR OWN
Keep personal affirmations in My Affirmations, right next to the ones we wrote for you.

BUILD YOUR STREAK
Open SayBright each day to grow your streak, and celebrate milestones at 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180 and 365 days.

SHARE CARDS
Turn any affirmation into a quote card for Stories, chats or anywhere you want to spread some light.

DAILY REMINDERS
Pick a time and SayBright sends one gentle reminder a day, so your daily affirmations become a habit.

FREE TO START
The free plan includes five affirmations a day, the full Confidence category, previews of every other category, streaks, share cards, reminders and your own written affirmations.

SAYBRIGHT PREMIUM
Premium opens all 10 categories and every positive affirmation with no daily limit, recordings in your own voice and watermark free share cards.

Premium is a monthly or yearly subscription with a 1 week free trial for eligible new subscribers. It renews automatically unless you cancel before the end of the current period. Cancel anytime in Google Play under Payments and subscriptions.

Privacy Policy: https://graysmithlabs.com/apps/saybright-privacy.html
